_comment: Classification table for dispatch_contract_gate.py (PreToolUse, matcher
Agent). Adding/removing an implementation-shaped subagent type or verb
is a DATA edit: change the lists below.
implementation_subagent_types - tool_input.subagent_type values that
count as implementation-shaped. `null` stands for
the key being ABSENT from tool_input entirely (a
dispatch with no explicit subagent_type), the
observed default shape -- not the string "null".
Shipped default is the conservative three-value set
below. TUNING KNOB: an operator running named/repo-
specific agent types (e.g. driver variants this
table does not enumerate) can add the sentinel "*"
to this list to match EVERY subagent_type -- cheap
to widen because the gate is warn-only (a false
positive costs an advisory line, not a refusal).
implementation_verb_pattern - regex (case-insensitive, searched, not
fullmatch) the prompt must contain for a dispatch
with an in-set subagent_type to be treated as
implementation-shaped. A read-only brief
('read X and summarize') with an in-set type still
passes through untouched.
contract_fence_pattern - regex (case-insensitive, DOTALL) matching the
fenced dispatch-contract block documented in
docs/orchestration/dispatch-contract.md. Presence
alone silences the warning; the gate does not
validate individual field values inside the fence.
task_id_pattern - regex (case-insensitive, MULTILINE, group 1 = the
id) picking a `task:` line out of the prompt for
the stamping seam's rollup-lane attribution.
Deliberately looser than contract_fence_pattern: a
partial/malformed contract (task named, closing
fence missing) still warns, but should attribute to
that task rather than the uncontracted bucket below.
uncontracted_task_id_bucket - the stable lane every warning with no
extractable task id rolls up under, so the WG.5
per-lane rollup aggregates repeated warnings
instead of minting one singleton lane per
tool_use_id.
warn_dedup_window_minutes - a repeat warning (same event_class, same
subagent_type) for THIS repo within this many
minutes of the last logged row is not re-logged --
the additionalContext warning still fires every
time (advisory, never suppressed); only the sink
write is throttled. Set to 0 to disable dedup.
arming - 'warn' is the only implemented mode today. This key exists so
a future fail-closed mode is a one-line data flip,
not a code change -- but the code does not yet
interpret any other value; refusal is deferred to
a follow-up sanctioned-fleet design lane. Any value
other than 'warn' is treated as 'warn' today.
